scope: Selected four-tuple, 20-byte IPv4 plus 20-byte TCP headers, ingress SYN+ACK only; no payload/options/fragments, routing, ARP or physical network. Codec rejection means outside profile or invalid encoding, not an RFC drop/reset claim. Egress DF=1, identification=0, TTL=64 are fixture choices; TCP state/ACK/timers come solely from IR.
